name: Mahalia
notes: The most guitar-and-live-band-facing young British voice in the section, and the guitar is the harmonic bed rather than a colour: "clean electric or acoustic guitar as the harmonic bed (**she plays it**)" with "4-chord cycles that cadence, guitar-voiced with add9 and open-string shapes". Guitar voicing is why `voicing.style` is close and the register is guitar-shaped rather than pad-wide, and why `susSubstitutionProb` carries the add9/open-string shapes. ⛔ **`bass808` is null**: "played electric bass with real motion on the band material; a round sustained sub on the trap-facing cuts. Slides are rare" — so the bass part is real and `glideProb` is near zero. The modelled kit is the first of her two: "a live-feel R&B kit, soft snare on 2&4 with ghost 16ths, played hats and hand percussion", with "finger-snaps and a tambourine layer throughout". The melody is "bright mid-alto with a conversational, slightly-clipped British delivery, moderate note-density, short repeated hooks, and close-harmony stacks" — clipped is `articulation` staccato, short repeated hooks is `twoBarCellRepeat`, and close-harmony stacks is a moderate counter ratio rather than the wide one this section usually asks for. ⚠ `confidence` is **low**, mirroring the entry's medium-low: "lane position and instrumentation sourced; parametric detail is inference". ⚠ All drum numbers, the swing amount and the bassline figures are **INFERRED**. ⚠ `session.bpm.mode` is **INFERRED**: the number is not stated in the entry, and it is an authored centre of gravity inside the band the entry does state. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **`drums.kick.lockTo808` removed (2026-08-17, 808 gate).** This kit has no 808 — `bass808` is `null` here or in the parent it inherits — and `lockTo808` is the one parameter that says *how much of the kick the 808 follows*, so in this file it described a pairing that does not exist: `generators::drums::bass808` returns on `block.is_none()` before the value is ever read, which makes it provably dead here. Where it was NOT dead was in the artists and producers who extend this kit and author an 808 of their own: they inherited the zero, `kicks.iter().filter(|_| rng.random_bool(0.0))` kept nothing, and their sub lane was silent at every seed — `bass808::every_shipped_model_with_an_808_produces_a_playable_line` reported "no 808 at all" for 35 of them. Removing it restores the engine's documented default of 1.0 for exactly those children and changes nothing here. ⚠ No researched claim moved: this kit's own statement about the 808 is the `bass808: null` beside it, and that is untouched.
